task_completion.description: The agent has opened the Webots simulation environment and located the DELIVERY_BOT node.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A screenshot showing the Webots application window with the DELIVERY_BOT visible in the scene tree or 3D view.

task_completion.description: The agent has expanded the DELIVERY_BOT node and selected the 'front_camera' device.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The scene tree on the left shows 'front_camera' highlighted or selected.

task_completion.description: The agent has set the noise to 0.05 and motion blur to 20.0 in the camera properties.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The field editor or scene tree shows 'noise' set to 0.05 and 'motionBlur' set to 20.

task_completion.description: The agent has set the radial lens coefficients to -0.3 and 0.05.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'lens' field under the camera node shows 'radialCoefficients' with values -0.3 and 0.05.

task_completion.description: The agent has set the focal distance to 1.2 and focal length to 0.02.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'focus' or 'lens' fields show 'focalDistance' set to 1.2 and 'focalLength' set to 0.02.

task_completion.description: The agent saves the modified world to the specific path /home/ga/Desktop/sim_to_real_camera.wbt.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A 'Save As' dialog box or a terminal command showing the file being saved to /home/ga/Desktop/sim_to_real_camera.wbt.

integrity.description: The agent interacted with the Webots GUI to modify parameters rather than just writing a file via terminal.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show the mouse cursor or highlighted fields within the Webots Scene Tree/Field Editor.

integrity.description: The agent did not simply run a pre-made script to generate the file without opening the software.
integrity.visual_evidence: The agent is seen navigating the Webots node hierarchy.

integrity.description: The agent modified the 'front_camera' specifically, not a generic camera or a different robot.
integrity.visual_evidence: The selection highlight in the Webots tree is clearly on the 'front_camera' child of 'DELIVERY_BOT'.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The required values for the 'front_camera' are: noise=0.05, motionBlur=20.0, radialCoefficients=[-0.3, 0.05], focalDistance=1.2, and focalLength=0.02. The final file must be saved exactly to /home/ga/Desktop/sim_to_real_camera.wbt. Ensure the agent is editing the DELIVERY_BOT's camera and not another object.
